about: Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C. is a personal injury firm with offices in Chicago and Waukegan.

The firm states that the first consultation is free; its intake line is open around the clock. It publishes material in English and Spanish. It does not state a fee model on its public pages, so none is recorded here.

completeness.note: Categories, opening hours and photo count come from the Places API. The owner's own description, the services list, the Q&A and recent posts are owner-side fields the API does not expose at any price, so they are not scored either way. The API does expose Google's editorial summary, which is a different thing: Google writes those about notable places and has written one for no firm in this directory.

json_ld_descriptions: Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C. is a leading personal injury law firm in Chicago, Illinois, focused on medical malpractice, birth injury, personal injury, and wrongful death cases. Our attorneys have secured record-setting verdicts and settlements for victims of medical negligence and catastrophic injuries.

At Salvi, Schostok & Pritchard P.C., our firm has earned a reputation as one of the top-rated personal injury law firms in Chicago. For more than 40 years, our attorneys have been negotiating and arguing against the titans of the insurance industry.
